variants.title: Промышленная архитектура
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high-resolution portrait visual proposal for the native iPhone app SALINI INSIGHT, an executive control tool for a premium mineral-cast sanitaryware manufacturer. Portrait 1:2 canvas, one complete flat front-on app screen, no phone hardware, no surrounding presentation board. Extremely polished, serious, authoritative, spacious and plausible to implement. Beautiful readable restrained SF-like typography, native iOS optical glass used only for floating navigation and the bottom decision board. The image must primarily demonstrate the proposed spatial visual language, not become a dense wall of UI. A true orthographic isometric view (45-degree azimuth, 35.264-degree elevation), parallel verticals, no perspective convergence, no tilt-shift blur, fixed camera. This is an illustrative demo digital twin, not the actual site plan. Show the SCALE of a substantial industrial campus: long halls, meaningful distances, two-lane service roads, loading aprons and wide truck turning radii, pedestrian routes separated from vehicles. Adult realistic workers and vehicles are very small scale cues, never toy figurines. Salini casts BATHTUBS, WASHBASINS and SHOWER TRAYS. Include mineral mixing tanks and pipework, grouped casting molds, extraction ducts in finishing, actual inspection tables with basins and trays, pallet racks, packaging and truck loading. Do not depict generic electronics assembly or a factory making only bathtubs. Furniture and mirrors may only appear boxed in fulfilment. Open on a focused roof-cutaway QUALITY CONTROL hall, with neighboring finishing, packing, warehouse and a smaller office in the wider context, not a distant view of the entire map. 55–60% of the screen is detailed but clearly legible spatial content, with three restrained attached labels, selective amber focus at the held batch and a thin connected route to a waiting truck. Sparse and genuinely hierarchical UI, substantial breathing room. Use these SAME short Russian strings exactly, with no gibberish or additional invented labels: header "salini" and "Insight"; small status "ДЕМО · 15:00"; site labels "Качество", "Упаковка", "Склад"; a subtle map-overview control. Bottom decision board: small amber eyebrow "ТРЕБУЕТ РЕШЕНИЯ"; strong title "Marea · контроль качества"; explanatory text "12 раковин задерживают рейс 02"; action "Открыть решение ↗". Beneath it a spacious horizontal row of compact stats: "2" / "Решения", "6,25 млн ₽" / "Портфель", "24" / "В работе". These are explicitly demo values. Delicate minimal navigation at bottom "Обзор" "Заказы" "События". No large decorative charts, no random labels, no cartoon trees, no floating disconnected buildings, no fluffy plastic, no game UI, no sci-fi holograms, no miniature toy aesthetics, no watermark. Spend rendering detail on credible architecture, light, materials, industrial equipment and a coherent material flow.
DIRECTION 01 — PORCELAIN ARCHITECTURE. Architectural visualization for a prestigious industrial design company, like a beautifully photographed large-scale architectural competition model but with physically plausible buildings and equipment, NOT a toy model. A luminous pearl-white campus with finely ribbed anodized aluminum facades, translucent sawtooth rooflights, cool pale-grey poured concrete, mid-graphite asphalt. Distinct saturated cobalt equipment and desaturated forest green buffer planting; amber reserved for the one operational risk. Delicate realistic ambient occlusion and long soft daylight shadows, precise chamfers and joinery. Crisp, materially rich surfaces at human building scale. The selected quality building has a surgically clean cutaway showing stainless inspection gantries, rows of different sanitaryware and glazed office partitions, with a full service courtyard and two longer halls beyond. White porcelain and slate visual hierarchy, very high-end architectural visualization, calm and clear. Bright UI with solid ink text and one thin frosted floating lower board. Not beige, not washed out. Small discreet style identifier "01 · ARCHITECTURE" at top edge outside the app content.
variants.cleanupPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact Salini Insight visual style proposal. ONE targeted cleanup: remove every invented English slogan and tiny decorative tagline printed on the building facade at the lower left and beneath the Salini logos on tanks/buildings; replace that writing with the exact same clean unlettered facade or metal surface. Keep all actual 'salini' logos, the top '01 · ARCHITECTURE' identifier, the entire Russian interface, the factory layout, framing, colors, equipment, lighting, geometry, roads and bottom panel completely unchanged. Preserve original high resolution, all detail and portrait aspect ratio. No new text or decorations.
